notes.title: Test keys recall + War in Ukraine
notes.notes:
Hi Guys, Piano Rocker dev is here.

There has been a first closed alpha version, i've figured out build pipeline + a major bug with rendering 3d mode has been discovered on windows, I'm working on it.

The overall development stopped for a month due to health/personal issues. I'm planning to continue, but can't give you exact dates, i'm still recovering.

As of today - more than a week passed since russia invaded my home country Ukraine. I'm safe in Berlin, but my family and friends are not. 

[url=https://supportukrainenow.org/]https://supportukrainenow.org/[/url] Please support the troops, raise awareness and I hope it will be over very soon.

notes.title: Alpha-1 (very first, very closed and very intimate)
notes.notes:
[h1]Piano Rocker is ready for a first rehearsal[/h1]

I have just requested first 10 keys for a little closed alpha test. 

5 are destined to land here, for people who're interested to be "early adopters" and potential OG evangelists. Leave a comment under this post, and i will approach you once I receive the steam keys.

[h2]Q&A[/h2]

[h3]Q: What's the purpose of this closed alpha?[/h3]
A: Two reasons: 
[olist]
[*] I want to test the first builds running on different platforms and setups
[*] I would like to build a group of active community members, that would provide me with feedback
[/olist]

[h3]Q: What's the planned outcome? [/h3]
The feedback I hope to get will contribute to "better" early access version..

[h3]Q: Is it free to participate? [/h3]
A: Of course it's free. Alpha keys will be revoked once the early access version is out , but worry not - i plan to send gift keys to all active community members 

[h3]Q: What's in this release? [/h3]
You can play a few built-in easy charts on a midi-compatible device of your choice (twinkle twinkle little star and happy birthday - confirmed).

[h3]also, you can and very encouraged to experiment with custom chart files, some basic skinning/color customizations and so on [/h3]

[h3]Where can i provide feedback / ask more questions? [/h3]
Everyone who'll get a key - will get an invitation to the early adopters discord (i'll just text you in steam for further details)

If you haven't made it in first 5 - please don't worry. Once we kick it off - there's gonna be a public discord server too, presumably with regular updates, and in general i am planning further test phases, so i'm sure you will be able to participate further on.

Still, if you feel like there's something urgent that has to be said - leave it under this post, i'll make sure to keep an eye on discussion.
